categories.name: Ration Denied or Short Supply
categories.name_hi: राशन से इनकार या कम आपूर्ति

steps.title: Collect Evidence
steps.description: Note the date, quantity denied, and name of the fair price shop dealer. Ask for a written receipt or note if denied.

steps.title: Contact the Helpline
steps.description: Call the UP Food helpline: 1967 (toll-free). Register your complaint and get a complaint number.

steps.title: Visit District Supply Office
steps.description: If helpline doesn't resolve, visit the District Food & Supply Officer with your ration card and complaint details.

steps.title: Online Complaint
steps.description: File complaint at fcs.up.gov.in → 'Complaint Registration'. Upload any evidence photos.

steps.title: Escalate to DM
steps.description: If unresolved in 15 days, submit written complaint to the District Magistrate (DM) office.

categories.name: Government Scheme Benefit Not Received
categories.name_hi: सरकारी योजना का लाभ नहीं मिला

steps.title: Check Application Status
steps.description: Visit the scheme's official portal to check if your application is approved, pending, or rejected.

steps.title: Visit Block Development Office
steps.description: For rural schemes, visit BDO with application receipt. For urban, visit Municipal Office.

steps.title: Call Scheme Helpline
steps.description: Call the specific scheme's helpline (e.g., PM Kisan: 155261, PMJAY: 14555) for status.

steps.title: File RTI Application
steps.description: Under Right to Information Act, file RTI with the concerned department to get status in writing.
steps.time: Within 30 days (RTI must be responded in 30 days)

steps.title: Approach District Collector
steps.description: File grievance at Jan Sunwai or through UP Jansunwai portal (jansunwai.up.nic.in).

steps.title: Do Not Pay the Bribe
steps.description: Firmly refuse. Note the official's name, designation, date, and what bribe was demanded.

steps.title: Call Anti-Corruption Helpline
steps.description: Call UP Anti-Corruption Helpline: 1064. Report with full details of the incident.

steps.title: File Complaint with Vigilance Commission
steps.description: Submit written complaint to UP Vigilance Establishment, Lucknow or file online.

steps.title: Report to Senior Officer
steps.description: Submit complaint to the accused officer's senior (e.g., DM if dealing with block-level officer).

steps.title: File FIR if Needed
steps.description: If bribe was paid, file FIR at local police station under Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.

categories.name: Pension Stopped or Not Received
categories.name_hi: पेंशन बंद हुई या नहीं मिली

steps.title: Check Status Online
steps.description: Visit sspy-up.gov.in → Pensioner Status. Check if Aadhaar is linked and bank account is active.

steps.title: Visit Block Office
steps.description: Visit your Block Development Office with Aadhaar and bank passbook. Ensure annual verification is done.

steps.title: Ensure Bank Account is Active
steps.description: Inactive or dormant bank accounts stop pension. Visit your bank branch to reactivate.

steps.title: File Online Complaint
steps.description: File complaint at sspy-up.gov.in or UP Jansunwai portal with pension ID and details.
